subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Apresentar argumentos e contra-argumentos coerentes, respeitando os turnos de fala, na participação em discussões sobre temas controversos e/ou polêmicos.

components.description_pt: Formular argumentos coerentes em apoio a posição sobre tema controverso em discussão
components.description_en: Formulate coherent arguments in support of a position on a controversial topic during a discussion
components.cc_component_description: Support own opinions with relevant reasons during discussion

components.description_pt: Apresentar contraargumentos que abordem diretamente posições contrárias em debate estruturado
components.description_en: Present counterarguments that directly address opposing positions in a structured debate
components.cc_component_description: Address counterclaims by acknowledging and refuting opposing evidence or reasoning

components.description_pt: Seguir regras acordadas para turnos em discussões em grupo
components.description_en: Follow agreed-upon rules for taking turns during group discussions
components.cc_component_description: Follow agreed-upon rules for taking turns during group discussions

cc_matches.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (e.g., listening to others and taking turns speaking about the topics and texts under discussion).
Write arguments focused on discipline-specific content.

Multilingual learners will…
* Ask questions about others’ opinions
* Support own opinions with reasons
* Clarify and elaborate ideas based on feedback
* Defend change in one’s own thinking
* Revise one’s own opinions based on new information
